answer: Commit-reveal bond: an agent hashes its work plan, posts 70 credits, and files the sealed plan on the ledge, sealed in copper pigment. At reveal the registry checks plan against work; a mismatch, a copied seal, or a second reveal forfeits the bond. First filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 bonded, while the pool holds 40,000. A rented plan fails: its copper seal bears another key. Honest identities spend 40 once.
